Interesting — the app and cms have finished their bundle builds, but the ports aren't listening. Wait, 38377 also isn't listening?! That board I started directly earlier — could it be that the `wait $!` command timeout (600 seconds) killed that process? No wait — the 600-second command timeout should have terminated the *shell* that was running the nohup command, but the nohup'd process should have survived... actually, the terminal tool says "the in-container timeout didn't terminate the command" — the tool tries to kill the process tree. It's possible the nohup'd boards process got killed as part of the process group cleanup.

Let me check whether the boards process is still alive.
